verdict.summary:
> 🤖 SPARQ agent

Round 1's author-forgery blocker is resolved. The report no longer reads the author-editable PR body as review evidence: it derives the reviewed head from a bot-login-filtered, line-anchored `human-arm` park receipt through the shared parser, whose quoted/fenced-context stripping and cause/class validation preserve the authority boundary. Missing identity, malformed heads, absent receipts, malformed comment history, and mismatched heads all refuse; only an authenticated exact 40-lower-hex head match admits. The CLI now requires the bot identity, the exit decision includes approval coverage, and the census zero-seals and separates approval refusals from gate-freshness refusals. The added end-to-end cases specifically keep a forged live-head body marker present while varying authenticated evidence, including an author-authored look-alike receipt and unreadable history, so the prior defect is tested non-vacuously.
